g.text: Redfin Data Center ZIP-code tracker, all residential, rolling 3-month windows ending May 2026. Fill is the change in median sale price vs the same window a year earlier; ZIPs with fewer than
10 sales are hatched. Lines show median sale price indexed to 100 five years earlier and smoothed with a 4-window moving average; the metro line is a sales-weighted average of ZIP medians.
ZIP areas are Census 2010 ZCTAs. Small ZIPs are volatile.
